name: database-decoy
description: Emulates MySQL/MariaDB, PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server login services to capture credential stuffing and lateral movement attempts. Every login fails.
author: Doppel
documentation: Runs unprivileged (UID 65532, no Linux capabilities) in host networking because all default database ports (3306, 5432, 1433) are at or above 1024. Read-only filesystem, no-new-privileges. Passwords (and MySQL auth scramble responses) are reported as an HMAC with the node's capture key by default (TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE=hash) so the Hub can match planted honeytokens without storing plaintext. Per-protocol enabled_key flags ensure disabled protocols do not hold ports.

config.name: TS_ENABLE_MYSQL
config.description: Enable the MySQL / MariaDB decoy listener

config.name: TS_MYSQL_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the MySQL decoy (>= 1024; no capabilities granted)

config.name: TS_MYSQL_VERSION
config.description: Server version string advertised in the MySQL Protocol 10 handshake

config.name: TS_POSTGRES_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the PostgreSQL decoy (>= 1024; no capabilities granted)

config.name: TS_ENABLE_MSSQL
config.description: Enable the Microsoft SQL Server (MS-TDS) decoy listener

config.name: TS_MSSQL_PORT
config.description: TCP port for the MS SQL Server decoy (>= 1024; no capabilities granted)

config.name: TS_MSSQL_SERVER_NAME
config.description: SQL Server persona name included in MS-TDS ERROR 18456 responses

config.name: TS_MSSQL_VERSION
config.description: SQL Server major.minor.build version advertised in MS-TDS PRELOGIN

config.name: TS_PASSWORD_CAPTURE
config.description: hash: HMAC with the node capture key; plain: clear text; none: not captured

config.name: TS_MAX_CONNS
config.description: Concurrent connections across all enabled listeners

config.name: TS_EVENT_COOLDOWN_SEC
config.description: Event rate-limit window in seconds per source (0 = report every attempt)

triggers.name: mysql_connection
triggers.description: MySQL/MariaDB connection closed without an authentication attempt

triggers.name: postgres_connection
triggers.description: PostgreSQL connection closed without an authentication attempt

triggers.name: mssql_connection
triggers.description: Microsoft SQL Server (MS-TDS) connection closed without an authentication attempt
